verdict.rationale: Docusign offers natural-language operation in two ways. The first is an official MCP server and Claude connector that let users query agreement status and metadata and trigger IAM workflow actions conversationally; the Gemini CLI pairing does the same from the terminal. The second is an in-product AI-powered chat for reviewing, redlining and drafting agreements. However, broad natural-language control of the product depends on external AI clients, and the native chat covers only review and drafting. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface for core operations like sending and managing envelopes, explicit evidence that MCP tools cover sending and signing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
